Hi Amit / Sara —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next step: a 30-minute product preview focused on your ingestion and privacy questions + a short ops/infra check. Goal is to demonstrate the flow for healthcare data ingestion, routing to a private deployment, and how audit logs surface in the Console.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue Jul 6, 10:00–10:30
- Option B: Tue Jul 6, 13:00–13:30 (preferred on our side for engineering availability)
- Option C: Wed Jul 7, 09:00–09:30

Please pick the option that works best and confirm which Medivex attendees will join. For the preview to be productive, can you include: an engineering/infra lead (to verify VPC/egress requirements) and the compliance contact (for retention/PII questions)? If you want, we can split the 30 minutes: 20 minutes product, 10 minutes ops Q&A.

I attached a short pre-demo checklist with the items we typically ask teams to have ready (sample data shape, network egress allowlist, and MFA/KMS notes). I also attached a draft mutual action plan to capture outcomes and owners after the session.

Next steps I’ll take after you confirm: send calendar invite with dial-in and the short agenda; loop in Priyom (Solutions Eng) to run the technical portion.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Thanks Amit — great, locking in Option B. I'll send the calendar invite after this note.

Quick answers to your asks:
1) Privacy bullet points we'll cover (short):
   - Data flow: what leaves Medivex network vs what stays in your VPC (prefixes/tokens).
   - PII handling: redaction and configurable retention policies per-model route.
   - Access and audit: how audit logs are surfaced in Console and available via BigQuery export.
2) Yes — please allowlist these outgoing ranges for the preview: 34.82.0.0/15, 35.190.0.0/16. These are used by our demo Dedicated region; if you need FQDNs instead I can provide them.

I attached the same checklist and a short one‑pager on how Private deployments map to your VPC.

Agenda I'll include on the invite:
- 0–5m: quick objective alignment
- 5–25m: product preview (ingest -> private route -> audit) led by Priyom
- 25–30m: ops/compliance Q&A

If Lina can't join live, we'll record and share the short clip of the audit walk.

I'll send the invite now.

Best,
Lauren
